message: The template '{0}' can only be referenced in a direct call. It cannot be assigned to a delegate, passed as an argument, or called with the '?.' operator.
title: A template can only be referenced in a direct call.
rationale: TemplateAnnotator.VisitIdentifierName reports it whenever a template method name is not the target of 'name(...)' or 'expr.name(...)', including conditional access 'expr?.name()', which a reader would consider a direct invocation; the current message does not say which usages are rejected. In the title, 'it' grammatically refers to the referencing template rather than the referenced one.
